cache_drift.explanation: The final selected host run found a new root pipeline fingerprint despite unchanged root-stage source paths, invalidating downstream cache keys. The existing fingerprint includes toolchain/environment and os.uname values; old immutable result records do not retain that complete contract, so the exact changed field cannot be retrospectively established. This caused additional prerequisite executions and repeated the 20 earlier successful focused methods under new fingerprints; they are not reported as reuse.
cache_drift.later_reuse: After the first host run, all six exact successful prerequisite fingerprints were reused on both corrected host attempts; no unchanged failed fingerprint was rerun.
cache_drift.future_efficiency_note: Inspect the planned pipeline status before executing another batch. If root fingerprints drift without source changes, diagnose environment/toolchain stability before launching dependency checks; do not forge prior fingerprints or delete evidence.
